notes: - **The Live window shows what is writing the live transcript and telling speakers apart: the service or model, and whether it runs on your graphics card or processor.** A line above the transcript follows what is really running. If the card gives out mid-meeting it switches to the processor and says so in words. Settings › Live window › **Live transcript by** adds **Last meeting used**. See [What is doing the work](/docs/live-window/#what-is-doing-the-work).
